subject: Mathematics
name: JHS 1 Mathematics
description: The JHS 1 Mathematics curriculum is designed to develop mathematical literacy, problem-solving skills, and critical thinking. It covers number systems, algebra, geometry and measurement, and handling data, preparing learners for real-life applications and further studies.

subStrands.title: NUMBER AND NUMERATION SYSTEMS
subStrands.description: Understanding place value and number operations.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding and the use of place value for expressing quantities recorded as base ten numerals as well as rounding these to given decimal places and significant figures

indicators.description: Model number quantities more than 1,000,000,000 using graph sheets, isometric papers and multi-base blocks

exemplars.description: Model number quantities up to 1,000,000,000 (one billion) using graph sheets or multi-base ten materials.
Use multiples of 10s, 50s, 100s and 200s to represent numbers in multiples of ways.
Use tokens (or paper-made currency notes) such as GHC20, GHC50, GHC100 and GHC200 to work out how many of each denomination would be required to model given amount up to one billion.

indicators.description: Compare and order whole numbers more than 1,000,000,000 and represent the comparison using ">, <, or ="

exemplars.description: Skip count forwards and backwards in 25s, 50s and 250s beginning from 1000.
Identify numbers which are for instance, 500,000 more than or less than a given 8-digit or 9-digit number.
Use phrases such as "is equal to", "is greater than" and "is less than" as well as their symbols such as ">", "<" and "=" to compare any two numbers.
Identify, read and write numbers in given positions in a number chart.

indicators.description: Round (off, up, down) whole numbers more than 1,000,000,000 to the nearest hundred-thousand, ten-thousands, thousands, hundreds and tens

exemplars.description: Round off whole numbers up to over 1,000,000,000 to the nearest hundred-thousands, ten-thousands, thousands, hundreds, etc.
Explain the differences between the "round up" and "round down" concepts.
Express whole numbers to significant figures.

indicators.description: Round decimals to the nearest tenth, hundredth, thousandths, etc.

exemplars.description: Round (off, up and down) decimals to the nearest tenths, hundredths, thousandths.

indicators.description: Express decimal numerals to given significant and decimal places

exemplars.description: Explain when zero (0) is significant in a decimal numeral.
Round given numbers to significant figures.
Express decimal numbers to a given number of decimal places.

contentStandards.description: Apply mental mathematics strategies and number properties used to solve problems

indicators.description: Multiply and divide given numbers by powers of 10 including decimals and benchmark fractions

exemplars.description: Recall multiplication facts up to 144 and related division facts.

Find the product of a given decimal number when it is multiplied by 10, 100, 1000, etc.

indicators.description: Apply mental mathematics strategies and number properties used to perform calculations

exemplars.description: Apply the halving and doubling techniques to determine the product of two given numbers.
Apply the distributive property to determine the product of two given numbers.

indicators.description: Apply mental mathematics strategies to solve word problems

exemplars.description: Play mental mathematics games using addition, subtraction, multiplication and division terms.
Play mental mathematics games involving cost, weight, fractions, perimeter, area, angles, time and decimals.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate an understanding of addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of (i) whole numbers, and (ii) decimal numbers, to solve problems

indicators.description: Add and subtract up to four-digit numbers

exemplars.description: Use partitioning (or expanded form) and place value system to add and subtract whole and decimal numbers.

indicators.description: Multiply or divide multi-digit numbers by 1- and 2- digit numbers

exemplars.description: Use partitioning/expanded form to multiply and divide efficiently.
Multiply whole numbers using the vertical place value method or lattice method.
Use the distributive property to multiply.
Investigate and determine basic division facts including divisibility test.

indicators.description: Create and solve story problems involving decimals on the four basic operations

exemplars.description: Solve word problems involving addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.
Solve word problems on data presented in a table.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding and the use of powers of natural numbers in solving problems

indicators.description: Illustrate with examples the meaning of repeated factors using counting objects such as bottle tops or bundle sticks

exemplars.description: Model repeated factors using counters or bottle tops.
Explain what is meant by a power of a number.

indicators.description: Express a given number as a product of a given number or numbers, as well as, in the form of a power or two such numbers as product of powers

exemplars.description: Express numbers as products of factors and in index form.

indicators.description: Show that the value of any natural number with zero as its exponent or index is 1 and use it to solve problems

exemplars.description: Verify why the value of any natural number with exponent zero is 1.

indicators.description: Find the value of a number written in index form

exemplars.description: Calculate values of numbers in index form.

indicators.description: Apply the concept of powers of numbers (product of prime) to find Highest Common Factor (HCF)

exemplars.description: Expand a given number using product of prime concept. Find the Highest Common Factor (HCF).

subStrands.title: FRACTIONS, DECIMALS AND PERCENTAGES

indicators.description: Determine and recall the percentages and decimals of given benchmark fractions (i.e. tenths, fifths, fourths, thirds and halves) and use these to compare quantities

exemplars.description: Review the concept of fractions (shading, equivalent fractions, simplest form, mixed numbers, improper fractions).

Simplify, compare and order common fractions.

indicators.description: Compare and order fractions (i.e. common, percent and decimal fractions up to thousandths) limit to the benchmark fractions

exemplars.description: Arrange fractions in descending order.
Find which decimal fraction is greater.

indicators.description: Explain the process of addition and subtraction of two or three unlike and mixed fractions

Subtract mixed fractions.

indicators.description: Solve problems involving addition or subtraction of fractions

exemplars.description: Solve word problems involving addition or subtraction of fractions.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate an understanding of the process of multiplying and dividing positive fractions and apply this in solving problems

exemplars.description: Multiply a whole number by a fraction.

Calculate percentages of numbers.

indicators.description: Find a fraction of given quantity (i.e. money or given quantity of objects)

indicators.description: Explain the process of dividing a fraction (i.e. common, percent and decimal fractions up to thousandths) by a 1-digit whole number and by a fraction

exemplars.description: Divide a whole number by a fraction.
Divide a fraction by a fraction.

indicators.description: Determine the result of dividing a quantity (i.e. money or objects) or a fraction by a fraction

exemplars.description: Solve word problems involving division by a fraction.
Solve word problems involving sharing quantities.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate an understanding of the concept of ratios and its relationship to fractions and use it to solve problems that involve rates, ratios, and proportional reasoning

contentStandards.description: Simplify algebraic expressions involving the four basic operations and substituting values to evaluate algebraic expressions

indicators.description: Perform addition and subtraction of algebraic expressions with rational coefficients

strands.title: GEOMETRY AND MEASUREMENT

Use the relationship between diameter and circumference to solve problems.

indicators.description: Determine the area of a triangle

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of bearings, vector and its components using real life cases
